android.desc:
Screen NSE/BSE stocks in real time using technical, intraday, and fundamental filters.

Key Features:
- Filter by RSI, MACD, moving averages, volume spikes, and more
- Scan for price action, breakout levels, and momentum moves
- Sort by P/E, ROE, revenue growth, profit margins, and debt
- Build and save filters that match your strategy
- Real-time updates, no delay

Screener Strategies:
- Gap up and gap down stocks — find intraday momentum at market open
- VWAP breakout — track institutional buying throughout the session
- Opening range breakout — capture the first 15-minute setup
- Volume shockers — detect abnormal activity before the move happens
- RSI oversold and overbought — spot reversal and momentum setups
- SuperTrend, MACD crossover, EMA crossover — trend-following signals
- Bollinger Band breakout — volatility expansion setups
- BTST and STBT stocks — overnight holding opportunities
- 52 week high breakout — stocks clearing long-term resistance
- Swing trade screener — 3 to 10 day holding setups

Sector & Index Screeners:
- Nifty 50, Bank Nifty, Nifty Midcap, F&O stocks
- Pharma, Banking, IT, FMCG, Auto sector screeners

Built For:
- Intraday and swing traders
- Technical analysts
- Fundamental investors
- Anyone who needs a fast, reliable stock screener

Visit: bottomstreet.com
